Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, learned counsel
for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Manoj Kumar, learned Standing
Counsel for the Union of India/ respondent
no.1.
3. Ms. Rajni Supyal, learned Brief Holder for
State of Uttarakhand/respondent nos.2 to 5.
4. Petitioner has challenged communication
issued by Chief Engineer, Level-1, Uttarakhand
Public Works Department on 18.01.2025.
5. By the said communication, petitioner
was informed that his request for renewal of
registration as contractor cannot be considered
as he has been blacklisted by Department and
order of blacklisting is under challenge in a
writ petition filed by petitioner before this
Court.
6. Learned counsel for petitioner has relied
upon an interim order passed by Co-ordinate
Bench in WPMB No.480 of 2024. In the said
writ petition, petitioner has challenged order of
blacklisting.
7. In that writ petition, an order was passed
on 04.10.2024 providing that till next date of
listing, petitioner will provisionally participate
in tender process.

2026:UHC:507-DB
8. Petitioner submits that Chief Engineer
Level-1 was under a duty to renew registration
of petitioner in terms of interim order passed
on 04.10.2024. The submission made on behalf
of petitioner cannot be accepted. Co-ordinate
Bench had only permitted petitioner to
participate in tender process but there is no
direction to competent authority to renew
petitioner's registration. Unless order of
blacklisting is set aside by this Court,
competent authority cannot grant renewal of
registration. Thus, impugned communication
cannot be faulted and it reflects correct legal
position.
9. Thus, there is no scope for interference.
The writ petition fails and the same is,
accordingly, dismissed. However, petitioner
shall be at liberty to move an application for
early hearing in WPMB No.480 of 2024.
